today: RFC 245 is a historical logistical document. It records the meeting arrangements and was issued as an RFC to distribute the information to all NWGM participants via the RFC channel. The practice of publishing meeting logistics in RFCs was common in the early ARPANET era.

sections.title: Hotel Reservations
sections.content: Project MAC has arranged guaranteed arrival reservations at the Hotel Sonesta in Cambridge, Massachusetts for people attending the Network Working Group meeting. The cost is $23.00 per night for a single room.
sections.eli5: You can stay at the Sonesta Hotel in Cambridge for $23 a night.

sections.title: Booking and Cancellation
sections.content:
Reservations were made through Project MAC for those who requested them. If a reservation needs to be cancelled, the hotel must be notified before 6 P.M. on the day of the reservation.

For dates October 9th, 10th, or 11th, cancel directly with the hotel. For other dates, contact Carol Falls at MIT Project MAC, extension 1450.
sections.eli5: If you need to cancel, call by 6 P.M. that day, either the hotel directly or Carol Falls at Project MAC.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: The Hotel Sonesta provides lodging for Network Working Group meeting attendees in Cambridge. Early cancellations should go through Project MAC to ensure proper handling.
sections.eli5: The hotel is ready for your stay if you cancel in time.
